# Lemonski Tours

Lemonski Tours offers private guided ATV and buggy tours in New Hampshire's North Country and the Ride the Wilds trail system.

## Business facts

- Business: Lemonski Tours
- Website: https://lemonski-tours.com/
- Phone: +1-603-703-3164
- Guide: James “Jay” Leeman, known as Jay or Lemonski
- Location: Berlin, New Hampshire
- Service area: Berlin, Gorham, and nearby North Country communities
- Tour length: Three hours
- Price: $200 per group
- Group size: Up to 10 buggies
- Schedule: Saturdays and Sundays at 9 am and 2 pm Eastern Time
- Vehicle: Guests bring their own legal, trail-ready machine or rent separately from a local rental company
- Included: Local guide and photos along the way
- Weather: Tours run rain or shine unless conditions are unsafe

## Important booking note

The tour booking reserves the guide's time. Guests pay Jay separately later. Buggy rental is separate and is arranged directly with a rental company.
